newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst shares climb, boosted by spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst shares climb, boosted by spin-off.

text.p: Shares in German chemicals and drugs giant Hoechst AG climbed 2.6 percent while the broader DAX index was down as investors continued to welcome news of spin-offs and acquisitions.
Hoechst shares, trading up 2.40 marks to 73.25 at 1220 GMT, were called the "totally hot share today," by one trader.
The company on Tuesday said it planned to spin off its specialty chemicals business to Swiss group Clariant AG .

On Wednesday the group announced plans to buy the 43.3 percent stake in French drugs group Roussel-Uclaf it does not already own, removing another key obstacle to a possible bourse listing for the group's drugs unit Hoechst Marion Roussel.
Dealers said there were switching operations into Hoechst and out of BASF AG.
Dealers also said the shares could climb as high 80 marks per share.
